Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (quatre actuellement dans le pipeline) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Une opportunité passionnante existe pour un professionnel talentueux, compétent en analyse, stratégique et hautement organisé avec une forte acuité commerciale pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse.

Votre impact

L'objectif du rôle est d'optimiser la performance du CIPH, d'identifier et de piloter les leviers clés, d'augmenter le taux de conversion pour stimuler les revenus, l'efficacité et l'efficience des canaux.
Optimiser la performance des entreprises à consommateurs en identifiant et en activant les principaux leviers de croissance qui améliorent la production de revenus sur les marchés et les sous-canaux d'affaires à consommateurs (B2C), la conversion, l'efficacité des canaux et l'efficience opérationnelle et d'investissement.

- Analyse des performances : surveiller et analyser les performances par rapport aux KPI de canaux et commerciaux, en fournissant des informations et des recommandations spécifiques de canaux par marché afin de maximiser les revenus par sous-canal de B2C (Web, Call Centre et Future Sales) et de stimuler l'amélioration continue. Posséder le développement, le suivi et l'action des principaux ICR.

- Conduire l'efficacité, quantifier ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA par sous-canal par marché pour optimiser continuellement les investissements. Recommander des réinvestissements vers des canaux à plus fort impact.

- Élaborer des modèles d'attribution pour identifier les leviers de canaux qui génèrent des recettes.

- Construisez et maintenez des fiches de performance B2C par marché pour surveiller et optimiser les performances des canaux B2C, en identifiant les points de chute. À la fois sur Excel et en partenariat avec l'équipe d'entreprise pour le rendre disponible dans des outils en libre-service (Power BI).

- Partenaire avec Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenu, IT, Call Centre et Future Sales afin d'améliorer les déplacements des clients, de réduire les frictions, d'augmenter la conversion, de répéter et la valeur de vie du client.

- Analyse concurrentielle : surveiller les conditions du marché, les activités concurrentielles et les tendances de l'industrie pour appuyer la planification stratégique et identifier les possibilités de différenciation et de croissance.

- Préparer des présentations prêtes pour les cadres supérieurs, avec des recommandations claires fondées sur des données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques des cadres supérieurs, en tirant parti de la visualisation des données stellaires combinée à la profondeur des idées.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- 5 ans d'expérience en analyse commerciale, intelligence d'affaires, analyse DTC ou performance eCommerce.

- préférence pour l'expérience antérieure dans l'hôtellerie de luxe/l'industrie du voyage ou les agences de conseil.

- Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, marketing, commercial ou domaine connexe (maîtrise, MBA ou expérience équivalente préférée).

Vos essentiels

- Expérience éprouvée pour soutenir les cadres supérieurs et prospérer dans un environnement de démarrage rapide, en gérant simultanément plusieurs priorités.

- Excellentes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en informations opérationnelles exploitables.

- Hautement compétent en Excel et confortable manipulant les données des grands ensembles de données et conservant de grands tableurs avec un haut niveau de précision

- Excellentes compétences en PowerPoint et en narration – capables d'élaborer des présentations propres, nettes et à impact élevé pour les auditoires C-suite.

- Expérience de travail avec Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics ou des plateformes similaires, ainsi que des outils BI et de visualisation tels que Tableau, Power BI, Looker ou des plateformes similaires.

- Connaissance des canaux de vente directe

- Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale. En anglais.

- Passion et curiosité d'apprendre continuellement l'industrie du voyage en constante évolution.

À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie.
Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer.
Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à Explora Journeys, où un océan d'opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l'état de l'océan commence ici.

Il tuo scopo
• Stiamo cercando un dinamico e altamente motivato Mobile App Product Specialist per unire il nostro team di Business Innovation presso MSC Crociere Sede a Ginevra. Questo ruolo è progettato per un professionista guidato dai dati con un forte acume commerciale, una mentalità analitica e una passione per l'ottimizzazione dei viaggi degli utenti mobili. Il candidato di successo esplorerà i comportamenti in-app, rimuoverà l'attrito nell'imbuto di vendita e guiderà iniziative orientate al prodotto per massimizzare i tassi di conversione e modellare il futuro delle esperienze degli ospiti digitali in tutto l'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me. Il tuo impatto - Analizzare il MSC per Me in-app viaggio utente e comportamento per identificare colli di bottiglia, proponendo e convalidando iniziative di prodotto che ottimizzano l'imbuto di vendita e aumentano i tassi di conversione in-app. - Collaborare con i team interfunzionali Product, Tech e UX/UI per progettare e implementare funzionalità che spingono l'acquisizione di utenti organici e aumentano le opportunità di cross-selling/up-selling per l'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me. - Implementare e ottimizzare la posizione in-app delle offerte commerciali (chiusura di lavoro con Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) per massimizzare la visibilità e le conversioni di vendita specificamente per gli utenti mobili. - Utilizza strumenti avanzati di analisi dei prodotti e visualizzazione dei dati (Power BI) per monitorare le prestazioni di vendita, i tassi di attivazione degli utenti e i drop-off nell'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me. - Agire come ponte tra il dipartimento commerciale di Onboard Revenues e i team Tech/Development, traducendo gli obiettivi di fatturato in requisiti di prodotto digitali chiari per migliorare l'ecosistema digitale MSC per Me. - Guidare l'acquisizione guidata da MSC per Me tramite la raffinazione di funzioni in-app native, come flussi di utenti senza attrito, meccanismi di invito-a-amico e condivisione di app senza fili, per aumentare la base dell'utente. - Condurre test A/B su MSC per Me flussi di vendita, processi di checkout e modelli di abbonamento per migliorare continuamente l'efficienza operativa e la generazione di ricavi. descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

- Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility.

- Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms.

- Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration.

- Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry.

- Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software).

- Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams.

- International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations.

- Willingness to travel extensively.

Your Essentials

- SWISS Resident or Visa Holder

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into effective people solutions, while ensuring consistent application of Group HR policies, processes, and standards. The Senior HRBP plays a key role in driving performance, engagement, and organisational effectiveness in a complex, international organisation where operational excellence, agility, and customer focus are critical. descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. Il vostro Essentials - Operazioni di prontezza e di ciclo di vita - Leader della forza lavoro su larga scala - Contabilità finanziaria e P&L - Gestione del ciclo di vita e della manutenzione - Gestione multioperatoria e delle concessioni Il nostro impegno Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza prospettive diverse, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valutato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il loro sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Your Impact 1. Operational Leadership Across the Asset Lifecycle Own end-to-end operational responsibility from pre-opening through live operations. Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS. Influence design decisions to ensure operational efficiency, safety and maintainability. Establish operating structures, SOPs and governance well ahead of opening. Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers. For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Establish Training Programs for operational readiness. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direct daily operations across all departments (hospitality, F&B, retail, attractions, marine, security, maintenance, guest services). Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards. Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening. Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operational P&L, cost controls and productivity metrics. Manage operating budgets, capex planning and lifecycle reserves. Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. Your Journey so far - 15+ years senior operations leadership in hospitality, cruise destinations, resorts, ports, theme parks or large hospitality assets. - Demonstrated ownership of both pre-opening and long-term operations. - Strong background working alongside development, construction and technical services teams. - Experience in Caribbean or island environments strongly preferred. descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Operationsdirektor ist verantwortlich für das Design, die Mobilisierung, die Eröffnung und den laufenden Betrieb von großen Kreuzfahrt- und Gastfreundschaft-Infrastrukturanlagen. Die Rolle sorgt für Kontinuität von der Entwicklung durch stationäre Operationen, die als Betriebsinhaber von frühen Bauphasen durch langfristige Leistung fungieren. Parallel zur Entwicklungs-, Bau- und Gasterfahrung garantiert der Leiter der Geschäftstätigkeit, dass die Vermögenswerte durch Design, vollständig bereit zur Eröffnung und nachhaltig effizient, sicher und profitabel sind. Ihre Auswirkungen 1. Operationelle Führung über den Asset Lifecycle Eigene operative End-to-End-Verantwortung von der Voröffnung durch Live-Operationen. Definieren Sie die Langzeit-Betriebsvision, Kennzahlen und Servicestandards. Gewährleistung der Kontinuität von Design, Kultur und Systemen von der Projektphase bis hin zu stationären Betrieben. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Führen Sie das betriebsbereite Programm im Einklang mit Bau Meilensteinen. In Abstimmung mit Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.) definieren Sie die Beschaffungsbedürfnisse und implementieren sie. FFE/OWS. Einflussentscheidungen zur Sicherstellung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Sicherheit und Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit. Stellen Sie operative Strukturen, SOPs und Governance vor der Eröffnung fest. Manage Handover von Bau zu Betrieb, einschließlich phased Umsatz. Für jedes Projekt sorgen Personalbedarf und - in Verbindung mit Personal - die operativen Fähigkeiten neuer Vermögenswerte. Ausbildungsprogramme für Betriebsbereitschaft einrichten. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direkte tägliche Operationen in allen Abteilungen (Krankheit, F&B, Einzelhandel, Attraktionen, Marine, Sicherheit, Wartung, Gastdienste). Vergewissern Sie sich die Lieferung von Gästeerlebnis, Sicherheit, Servicequalität und Markenstandards. Führen Sie die Betriebsstabilität während der Hoch- und Reifephase aus. Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in der gesamten Anlage. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Aufbauen, führen und behalten eine hochperformierende, multinationale Arbeitskräfte. Bewahren und entwickeln Sie Trainingsprogramme nach der Öffnung. Eine sicherheitserste, serviceorientierte und leistungsorientierte Kultur einbetten. 5. Finanz- und Handelsleistung Eigene operative P&L, Kostenkontrollen und Produktivitätskennzahlen. Verwalten Sie Betriebsbudgets, Capex-Planung und Lebenszyklusreserven. Zusammenarbeit mit kommerziellen Teams zur Optimierung des Umsatzes (F&B, Einzelhandel, Erfahrungen, Küstenausflüge, gegebenenfalls). 6. Compliance, Sicherheits- und Risikomanagement Gewährleistung der fortlaufenden Einhaltung aller regulatorischen, maritimen, gesundheitlichen, Sicherheits- und Umweltstandards. Führen Sie Notfallvorbereitung, Krisenmanagement und Unternehmenskontinuitätsplanung. Servieren Sie als verantwortliche Exekutive für Audits und Inspektionen. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7.
